original_test_intent: Validate the platform-defined IOHUB UCP parity condition at the intended internal structure, using the owner-approved errortype-2 command only if it is truly intended, and verify the exact corrected/uncorrected disposition, attributable evidence, service impact and recovery.
original_method: Obtain the authoritative definition of UCP and whether the commented line is an executable step or documentation only; map IOHUB instance/group/structure; validate errortype 2; decode FF5/FFE threshold; define OS-specific MCA/WHEA signature and reset policy; after explicit approval run one stimulus under OOB monitoring; correlate source/severity and health outcome; restore threshold and all RAS/HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE decides whether the commented command is intentional, defines UCP severity and target, applies approved threshold/RAS state, supervises one injection if authorized and restores the platform.
required_inputs: Owner decision whether the commented errortype-2 line is an executable step, example or intentionally disabled
Vendor definition of IOHUB UCP and proof of errortype 2 stimulus/severity/reset semantics
Socket/die/NBIO-to-IOHUB instance map and groupid 7/structid 1 definition
MCA threshold FF5/FFE encoding, before/target/restore values and rationale
Exact Linux MCA/APEI or Windows WHEA source/status/severity and expected no-reset/reset/service outcome
Supported OS method, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and restoration
safety_requirements: Do not uncomment or execute until owner/vendor authority confirms intent and semantics
Dedicated SUT with OOB console and known-good recovery path

No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff threshold, Platform First, NBIO, FCH and HDT state

Collect read-only source confirmation, raw settings, MCA/APEI/WHEA, BMC/UEFI and health evidence
Do not uncomment, choose tuple/threshold/outcome, change BIOS/HDT, inject/reset/retry/recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve commented-command intent and UCP definition

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The only injection line is commented, while Criteria assume execution. UCP is undefined and called correctable without a severity/reset oracle; errortype 2 and group/structure lack authority; FF5/FFE behavior, Windows method, timeout and RDIMM relevance are unspecified. DeepSeek erases the comment boundary.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review can identify the intended UCP parity domain and exact missing decisions. Execution is pending owner confirmation rather than the review being irreducibly blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 71 Wistron-System RAS-00791-V002: state whether the commented errortype=2 command is intended for execution; define IOHUB UCP and its correctable/uncorrectable/reset semantics; map instance0/group7/struct1; define FF5/FFE threshold encoding and restoration; specify exact MCA/APEI/WHEA oracle for each OS, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and full restoration.

review_improvement: Preserves the source comment as an execution boundary and separates command intent, UCP semantics and threshold behavior instead of silently turning ambiguous documentation into a runnable fault injection.
independent_technical_reasoning: A leading comment marker can mean an example, disabled feature or editorial artifact; all three have different execution authority. The sequence errortype 0/1/2 suggests related modes but does not define UCP severity. Because threshold and SyncFlood settings can change the outcome, guessing the acronym or uncommenting the line could convert a nominally correctable case into a reset-producing one.
